name: x_v2_oauth1_writes
summary: X (Twitter) v2 WRITE-PATH connector — STDLIB-ONLY OAuth 1.0a HMAC-SHA1 signing per RFC 5849 §3.4. Companion to bearer-read `twitter.py`: that module handles GET (bearer); this module handles POST/DELETE (user-context OAuth1). Zero deps — no tweepy. Auto-config via XV2OAuth1WriteConnector.from_env() reads NEW family first (X_API_KEY, X_API_SECRET_KEY, X_ACCESS_TOKEN, X_SECRET_TOKEN) with OLD family fallback (X_CONSUMER_KEY, X_CONSUMER_SECRET_KEY, X_ACCESS_TOKEN, X_ACCESS_SECRET_TOKEN), matching twitter.py::_load_env_for_profile family-preference logic.
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass. ~50 LOC inline RFC-5849 signer: pct-encode → canonical-param string → HMAC-SHA1 with key='pct(consumer_secret)&pct(access_secret)' → base64 → Authorization: OAuth header. v2 endpoints take application/json bodies which per RFC §3.4.1.3.1 are NOT included in the signature base (only x-www-form-urlencoded bodies are). Status semantics mirror twitter.py: 200=connected, 401=BadCreds, 402=CreditsDepleted (auth works, plan exhausted), 403=ScopeMissing.

env_vars.X_SECRET_TOKEN: OAuth 1.0a user access secret (NEW family, preferred)
env_vars.X_ACCESS_SECRET_TOKEN: OAuth 1.0a user access secret (OLD family, fallback)

substrate: studio/third_party/x_v2_writes/ (per-config persistence) + ~/.cc/third_party_logs/x_v2_writes_sends.jsonl + crystal chain (tier='social_event', model='x_v2_oauth1', scope='x_<tool>')

inbound_callers: core/lib/third_party/generative_mcp.py (write path, when wired — currently routes through twitter.py + tweepy)
routing_connections.substrate_writes: send_log entries + crystal chain when verify/post/dm succeeds

guarantees: Zero deps — stdlib only (urllib, hmac, hashlib, base64, secrets, time)
RFC 5849 §3.4 compliant — pct-encoding uses unreserved set ALPHA/DIGIT/-/./_/~
Status semantics distinct — 200/401/402/403 separable so wiring bugs are isolable from billing/scope
Crystal-anchor-ready — every write emits tier='social_event', model='x_v2_oauth1', scope=f'x_<tool>'
Companion-clean — does NOT shadow twitter.py reads; SERVICE='x_v2_writes' is distinct
Family-preference — NEW env vars win, OLD env vars fall back; Tom can migrate incrementally
blocking_dependency: Tom's free-tier account 2041731826381668352 may return 402 CreditsDepleted even with valid OAuth1 because X gates writes on tier too. Connector wiring is independently verifiable (verify_oauth1_creds distinguishes 401 from 402). Resolution: refill credits at developer.x.com OR upgrade plan.

companion_to.split_rationale: Bearer auth (App-only, twitter.py) covers reads. OAuth 1.0a (user-context, this module) covers writes. X v2 requires user-context for tweet/DM/like/retweet — bearer alone is insufficient. The split lets read path stay zero-dep (just bearer + urllib) and lets the write path stay zero-dep too (stdlib HMAC-SHA1) — eliminating the tweepy dependency twitter.py previously needed for writes.

usage_example:
from core.lib.third_party.x_v2_oauth1_writes import XV2OAuth1WriteConnector
c = XV2OAuth1WriteConnector.from_env()
status = c.connect()  # 'x_v2_writes_connected' | '..._no_credits' | '..._bad_creds' | '..._scope_missing'
if c._verify_cache and c._verify_cache.get('status') == 200:
    r = c.send('post_tweet', 'hello world')
    print(r.metadata.get('tweet_id'))
else:
    print('see c._verify_cache for diagnosis')
phase: D.3 of lively-enchanting-parrot plan (write-path split — replaces tweepy dep in twitter.py)
